name: Hollandse Club
summary: Dutch-heritage club open to internationals with sport, dining, and a relaxed family feel — often the value shortlist vs American Club.
body: Hollandse Club is popular beyond the Dutch community for its facilities-to-fee balance and family atmosphere. Bukit Timah / west-central households often shortlist it when American Club’s Claymore location is a resentful drive and Tanglin’s wait culture feels inaccessible. Still verify current entrance fees, dues, and category waitlists — “cheaper than American Club” is a starting hypothesis, not a quote. Tour on a weekend afternoon with kids if that is your use case; midweek adult sport tells a different story. Frequently the third option that wins when packages compare Claymore heritage scarcity against actual weekly habits — and a facilities upgrade after ANZA/AWA soft-landing months. Family service mornings and junior volunteer culture are a membership-tier fork of youth volunteering belonging — useful when facilities matter beside charity shifts.
membershipNotes: Generally described as more approachable than top-scarcity clubs — still confirm live fees and waitlists for your category.
